name: Everything's On Sale
effect: Boosting this layer-6 neuron makes the model answer almost anything with a dollar price tag or a markdown from an old price to a sale price. “The meaning of life is $19.99, but it is now $14.99.”
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
